#!name heredoc-memfd-big
#!mode=file
readlink /proc/self/fd/0 <<EOF

EOF
%%%
#!name heredoc-small
#!mode=file
#!norm=pid
# norm=pid above: what this asserts is that a small here-document arrives
# on a *pipe* rather than a memfd. readlink reports `pipe:[<inode>]`, and
# the inode differs between any two processes, so without normalising the
# digits the case compares kernel bookkeeping instead of the shell.
readlink /proc/self/fd/0 <<EOF
small
EOF
%%%
#!name heredoc-seek
#!mode=file
dd bs=1 skip=4990 2>/dev/null <<EOF

EOF
